; Reconcile the visible memo marker tag whenever a document is opened.
;
; The memo marker (📝) is a denormalized hint on the PARENT doc; the real link lives in
; rmh-memo-links.cfg. Tapping the memo button always re-creates (it means "I want a
; memo"), so it can't be the place that REMOVES the tag. Instead, on every document open
; (onDocumentChanged) we check the opened doc's linked memo: if the memo is gone/trashed
; we strip the marker and drop the dead link; if alive we ensure the marker is present.
; This also removes the legacy "Memo" text marker from an earlier iteration.
;
; Idempotent: only writes tags when they actually change, so it doesn't churn the list.
; Uses the general base/global helpers Values.rmhReadFile / rmhWriteFile. `common` (Values)
; and Library/LibraryController are already in DocumentView's scope.
AFFECT [[1224665461898798997]]
    TRAVERSE [[8397993708429497603]]
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL INSERT {
            function rmhReconcileMemoTag() {
                if (!document || !document.id) return;
                let rmhDocId = document.id;
                let rmhLinksPath = "file:///home/root/.local/share/remarkable/xochitl/rmh-memo-links.cfg";
                Values.rmhReadFile(rmhLinksPath, (links0) => {
                    let links = links0 || ({});
                    let memoId = links[rmhDocId];
                    let pe = Library.entryForId(rmhDocId);
                    let pts = (pe && pe.tags) ? pe.tags.map((t) => "" + t) : [];
                    let base = pts.filter((t) => t !== "📝" && t !== "Memo");
                    let applyDead = () => {
                        if (base.length !== pts.length) LibraryController.setEntryTags(rmhDocId, base, []);
                        if (memoId) { delete links[rmhDocId]; Values.rmhWriteFile(rmhLinksPath, links); }
                    };
                    if (!memoId) { applyDead(); return; }
                    let rmhMetaPath = "file:///home/root/.local/share/remarkable/xochitl/" + memoId + ".metadata";
                    Values.rmhReadFile(rmhMetaPath, (meta) => {
                        let alive = !!meta && (meta.parent !== "trash") && !!Library.entryForId(memoId);
                        if (alive) {
                            if (pts.indexOf("📝") < 0 || base.length !== (pts.length - 1)) {
                                let want = base.concat(["📝"]);
                                LibraryController.setEntryTags(rmhDocId, want, []);
                            }
                            // Auto-open the linked memo alongside in the split. Defer via timer
                            // so the split Loader instantiates before openDocument is called.
                            root.rmhPendingMemoId = memoId;
                            if (typeof rmhDocumentViewSplit !== "undefined" && rmhDocumentViewSplit) {
                                if (Values.rmhSplitMode === Values.RmhSplittingMode.Off) Values.rmhSplitMode = Values.RmhSplittingMode.Divided;
                                Values.rmhSplitRatio = Values.RmhSplittingRatio.Half;
                                rmhMemoAutoOpenTimer.restart();
                            }
                        } else {
                            applyDead();
                        }
                    });
                });
            }
            Connections {
                target: root
                function onDocumentChanged() { root.rmhReconcileMemoTag(); }
            }
            property string rmhPendingMemoId: ""
            Timer {
                id: rmhMemoAutoOpenTimer
                interval: 500
                onTriggered: {
                    let me2 = root.rmhPendingMemoId ? Library.entryForId(root.rmhPendingMemoId) : null;
                    if (me2 && typeof rmhDocumentViewSplit !== "undefined" && rmhDocumentViewSplit && rmhDocumentViewSplit.item) {
                        rmhDocumentViewSplit.item.openDocument(me2);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
